## Architecture Overview

The `Labels` type in prometheus has THREE implementations selectable via build tags: slice (`type Labels []Label`), stringlabels (`struct { data string }`), and deduplabels (`struct { syms *nameTable; data string }`). The slice implementation in `model/labels/labels_slicelabels.go` is the default. Changing from slice to struct breaks all code that directly iterates, indexes, or constructs Labels as a slice.

## Detailed Analysis

### Core Definitions

- **`model/labels/labels_slicelabels.go`** (line 33) — `type Labels []Label` (slice implementation).
- **`model/labels/labels_stringlabels.go`** (lines 34-36) — `struct { data string }` (string implementation).
- **`model/labels/labels_dedupelabels.go`** (lines 33-36) — `struct { syms *nameTable; data string }` (dedup implementation).
- **`model/labels/labels_common.go`** (245 lines) — Shared methods: Range(), Map(), FromMap(), Builder.

### Key Files With Direct Slice Access (Break)

- **`discovery/kubernetes/kubernetes.go`** — Heavy Labels[...] indexing and range operations.
- **`discovery/kubernetes/endpoints.go`** — Direct Labels slice construction.
- **`notifier/alertmanager.go`** — `Labels{}` struct literal construction.
- **`cmd/promtool/backfill.go`** — `Labels{}` literal construction patterns.

### Cross-Repo Impact

- **`thanos/pkg/store/bucket.go`** — Extensive Labels slice operations and indexing.
- **`thanos/pkg/block/index.go`** — Direct Labels indexing and slice construction.
- **`mimir/pkg/frontend/querymiddleware/codec_protobuf.go`** — Direct `Labels[0]` indexing.
- **`mimir/pkg/streamingpromql/testutils/compat_fixup_labels_slice.go`** — Labels slice compatibility.
- **`loki/pkg/chunkenc/memchunk.go`** — Labels slice access with direct indexing.
- **`loki/pkg/querier/queryrange/marshal.go`** — Labels slice serialization.
